title: Lunden measurement data for Unreal (#2245)
description: measurements.json written by tools/unreal-engine/export-world.mjs from src/config.js, data/plan.json, data/elevation.json and the built web world: the numbers Unreal logic reads instead of copying them (levels, spawn, player, stair, doors with hinge and swing, windows, lights, terrain grid reference, site, material keys, the position-test fixture). Points carry both web metres (`web`, x east / y up / z south) and Unreal centimetres (`unreal`, X = 100x, Y = 100z, Z = 100y; tools/unreal-engine/coordinates.mjs).

box.description: plan metres {x0, x1, z0, z1, y0, y1}: a node belongs to the first zone that holds the centre of its world bounding box (and accepts its builder, `from`)

from.description: #2279: the web builders this zone takes objects from (exterior, visit, core-l, portik, surroundings, surroundings-site, garage, core-abc); absent = any part of buildWorld (the l1007 zones)

split.description: #2279: merged meshes are cut at this zone's box sides and each piece goes to the zone holding its centroid

skip.description: #2280: what this zone leaves to other issues (a name pattern of the object or its parents, or a leaf material)

only.description: #2281: the only objects this zone takes (a name pattern of the object or its parents, or a leaf material)

fall.description: #2284: the web fall-damage rule (src/config.js FALL, COMBAT.lives) with sample results of src/falldamage.js: drops in metres, damage in lives (null = not reported)

surface.description: #2300: the footstep surface under the feet, src/stepsurface.js stepInfo sampled by tools/unreal-engine/export-player.js: a ground raster and height-dependent boxes (Unreal cm), the stair levels, named control points and random samples with the web's answers

rest.description: #2300: rest spots of the exported furniture (src/rest.js restTarget) with eye, aim, yaw and start view in Unreal terms, and the REST limits (degrees, cm)

respawn.description: #2300: the wake points a death may use (src/respawn.js grid candidates the web accepts), the wake yaw and the src/fall.js blackout timings

lightBounds.description: Stair shaft and ground-floor approach passage, metres [xMin,zMin,yMin,xMax,zMax,yMax].

id.description: node id in the zone GLB (null: the door is in a zone not exported); with `parts` (#2314) the interactable's id, and the leaf is those nodes

kind.description: src/doors.js: swing = SwingDoor (hinge + angles), sliding / wardrobe = sliding panels (centre + size); #2314: overhead = the garage door (pivot, axis, angleDeg, checkClosed/checkOpen like a window sash)

parts.description: #2314: the GLB nodes of a leaf exported as several nodes (Hus L's stairwell doors, the entrances of Hus A/B/C, the garage door's sections)

wireId.description: Optional public room id from the matching DoorSync registration (#2293)

leafType.description: #2328: moving leaf from CoreHouse or Garage.cageDoors

opening.description: Web metres. The visitor's feet must be below top, strictly between z0 and z1, and within radius + xMargin of x.

house.description: #2314: l, a, b or c for a stairwell door

kind.description: lamp = a light-giving object or patio fence-string light; room = a room's ceiling/pendant light point (src/lights.js)

stairVisibility.description: Lamp wash anchors within range of the stair and passage. An anchor outside both bounds retains only its weight in a multi-anchor lamp.

objectPosition.description: World origin of the fitting that supplies a lamp. Its x/z identify anonymous fittings even when the light is offset.

terrain.description: a reference to data/elevation.json (grid origin/step/size and its hash), not a copy of the heights

livingWallLight.description: L1007 painted east wall and the web window diffuse field. Metres in Unreal axis order. Samples are row-major from low to high, column along south.

leafLitter.description: #2433: fallen autumn leaves (src/leaflitter.js, LEAF_LITTER): the web's density map over WALK as a grey PNG (row j at z0 + (j + 0.5) cell, column i at x0 + (i + 0.5) cell, web metres) and the ground patch's numbers. months, fresh and old run January to December; colours are linear RGB.

hash.description: hash of the texels (not of the PNG bytes)

gravelSurface.description: #2433: the shared gravel map (src/gravelsurface.js gravelData): an sRGB colour tile and a linear relief (R) / roughness (G) tile, `size` px per `tile` m of world-metre UVs, as base64 PNGs; `mean` is the colour map's linear mean that the web divides each surface's colour by.

facadeLighting.description: #2324: room and wall-light data for the requested building zones. Positions and lengths are in Unreal centimetres, normals are horizontal unit [X,Y], routine times are local hours.

surfaces.description: the additive wall washes and ground pools (web triangles in Unreal cm, uv per vertex); colour is the web's sRGB hex, peak its full-fade opacity. #2397: courtyardBollardPools when gard is exported.

bollardLight.description: #2397: the courtyard bollard pools' on/off night thresholds, fade seconds, colour and peak (src/config.js COURTYARD.bollards.pool)

bollardBands.description: #2430: the courtyard bollards' bands under the caps (src/courtyard.js; when gard is exported): lit sRGB hex while the night fraction is strictly above `on` with power, else `off`; upright band triangles in Unreal cm, 1 mm proud of the imported band, uv per vertex

materials.description: material key → the web material's look (no web material has a name; the key is built from type, colour, roughness, metalness, opacity, emissive, vertex colours, textures, sides). Unreal maps keys to hand-made materials. Since #2308 `map` names the colour map (e.g. 'shared-grass-detail' on the lawns, src/grass.js) or is null. Since #2435 a web unlit label kept with its image (a `bas` key with `texture`) has `unlit: true` and `powerCut`, the share of its colour a power cut leaves on the web (1: unchanged).

ground.description: #2280: the walkable ground of the zones l1007-entre, gard and omgivning (export-scene.js groundProbes): the nodes build_site.py gives collision, control points with the elevation grid and the web's drawn terrain, and the walking route; tools/unreal-engine/tests/test_site.py traces and walks them. Optional: absent in exports without those zones.

reference.description: elevation = the web's terrain is data/elevation.json here; terrain = the web's designed ground (courtyard, river valley)

interaction.description: #2285: the room switches (node id, room and level: a switch turns that room's lights on and off) the taps (outlet, landing point, pick point) and the lifts' buttons for Unreal's interaction builder (tools/unreal-engine/python/build_interaction.py). Optional: absent in older exports.

lamps.description: ids of the room's lights (measurements.json lights, kind room) = #2283's lamp:<id> actor tags

liftButtons.description: the lifts' car buttons (one per stop) and landing call buttons, src/liftpanel.js; house l/a/b/c

vegetation.description: #2281: every exported tree (trunk node id, foot, crown radius, lobe count, height above the foot and height class) and hedge (node id, zone, box centre and size, height class); tools/unreal-engine/tests/test_vegetation.py finds each in Unreal. Optional: absent in exports without the vegetation zone.

blocks.description: #2308: half-width (m) of the diamond the web stops the walker with at this trunk (src/farwalk.js), null where the web does not block (inside the home block)

trunkCollision.description: #2308: the web's trunk blocking rule (src/farwalk.js; WALK.trunk by kind, OUTDOOR, WALK); build_vegetation.py builds it, test_vegetation.py walks into sampled trunks

buildings.description: #2279: measurement rays through Hus L, Hus A/B/C and the garage (export-scene.js buildingProbes), cast on the exported nodes of their zone; Unreal traces the same rays (tools/unreal-engine/tests/test_exterior.py). Optional: absent in exports without those zones.

expect.description: clear = an intentional passage (no hit); glass = intentional glazing

hit.description: first hit: web (m), unreal (cm), distanceCm, node (export id), materialKey

furnishing.description: #2289: every exported furniture/appliance/lamp node's web world transform in web and Unreal terms (`items`; Unreal axes = the actor's forward/right/up unit vectors), and every base-colour texture the GLBs keep for furnishing materials (`textures`: id, the repository images it shows, material keys, nodes and mesh nodes with their world centre). Checked in Unreal by tools/unreal-engine/tests/test_furnishing.py.

patioBeers.description: #2406: the slat table's two pints: each glass group node, its base and its meshes' world centres (web m, Unreal cm), and their date and hour window.

webRotationY.description: radians about web +Y (three.js rotation.y; the leaf runs along (sin a, cos a))

unrealYaw.description: degrees; the leaf's direction from the hinge in Unreal
